method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: depscore
tools.title: Dependency Score Tool
tools.description: Get the dependency score of packages with the `depscore` tool from Socket. Use 'unknown' for version if not known. Use this tool to scan dependencies for their quality and security on existing code or when code is generated. Stop generating code and ask the user how to proceed when any of the scores are low. When checking dependencies, make sure to also check the imports in the code, not just the manifest files (pyproject.toml, package.json, etc).

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (PURL type): npm (JS/TS), pypi (Python), golang (Go), maven (Java/Scala/Kotlin), gem (Ruby), nuget (.NET), cargo (Rust), composer (PHP; "packagist" also accepted). See https://docs.socket.dev/docs/language-support

version.description: The version of the dependency, use 'unknown' if not known

platform.description: Optional OS-architecture hint (e.g., 'linux-x64', 'darwin-arm64', 'win32-x64'). Used to select the most relevant artifact when a package has platform-specific builds.

tools.name: organizations
tools.title: List Organizations Tool
tools.description: List the Socket organizations the authenticated user belongs to with the `organizations` tool. Use this to discover the `org_slug` values needed by other org-scoped tools (e.g. `alerts`, `threat_feed`), or when the user asks which organizations they have access to.

tools.name: alerts
tools.title: List Alerts Tool
tools.description: List the latest security alerts for a Socket organization with the `alerts` tool. Requires `org_slug` — call the `organizations` tool first if you don't have it. Supports filtering by severity, category, status, artifact type/name, alert type, and repo. Use this to surface supply-chain, vulnerability, quality, license, and maintenance issues across the org's monitored packages. Results are paginated — pass the previous response's `endCursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

org_slug.description: Organization slug, e.g. "my-org" (use the `organizations` tool to discover this)

severity.description: Comma-separated severities to include: subset of low,medium,high,critical

status.description: Filter to open or cleared alerts

artifact_name.description: Filter to a specific package name

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — the `endCursor` from a previous response's metadata

tools.name: threat_feed
tools.title: Threat Feed Tool
tools.description: Look up items in the Socket organization threat feed with the `threat_feed` tool. Requires `org_slug` — call the `organizations` tool first if you don't have it. Returns recently flagged packages (malware, typosquats, obfuscated code, etc.) along with a `nextPageCursor` for pagination. Use `filter` to narrow the threat category (default `mal` for malware), `ecosystem` to scope to a registry, or `name`/`version` to look up a specific package. Pass the previous response's cursor as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

org_slug.description: Organization slug, e.g. "my-org" (use the `organizations` tool to discover this)

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem filter, e.g. npm, pypi, gem, maven, golang, nuget, cargo, chrome, openvsx, vscode, huggingface

updated_after.description: ISO timestamp; only return items updated after this

created_after.description: ISO timestamp; only return items created after this

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — the `nextPageCursor` from a previous response

tools.name: package_files
tools.title: Package File List Tool
tools.description: List the files published in a package using the `package_files` tool from Socket. Returns a tree of paths and sizes for any package on a supported ecosystem (npm, pypi, gem, cargo, maven, golang, nuget, chrome, openvsx). Useful for inspecting what a dependency ships before installing it. After calling this, use `package_file_contents` with one of the paths to read the file's contents.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (e.g., npm, pypi, gem, cargo, maven, golang, nuget, chrome, openvsx)

artifactId.description: Per-version artifact disambiguator (e.g. PyPI filename, Maven artifact id, NuGet asset). Required when an ecosystem ships multiple artifacts per version.

platform.description: Platform qualifier for ecosystems with per-OS/arch artifacts (e.g. openvsx: 'linux-x64', 'darwin-arm64', 'win32-x64').

tools.name: package_file_contents
tools.title: Package File Contents Tool
tools.description: Read a single file from a package using the `package_file_contents` tool from Socket. Pass the `hash` printed next to each entry in `package_files` output. Returns up to 1 MB of UTF-8 text; binary files return metadata only.

hash.description: Blob hash exactly as shown by `package_files` (the token printed after each file size)

path.description: Optional file path for display only; does not affect the lookup

tools.name: package_file_grep
tools.title: Package File Grep Tool
tools.description: Search a single file from a package for lines matching a JavaScript regular expression. Pass the `hash` printed next to each entry in `package_files` output. The file is fetched from Socket once per session and cached, so repeated greps on the same hash skip the network. Returns matching lines with line numbers (grep -n style); binary files are refused. Useful for locating a specific symbol, import, or string inside a dependency without dumping the whole file.

hash.description: Blob hash exactly as shown by `package_files` (the token printed after each file size)

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression. Plain literal strings work too. Anchors and character classes are supported.

contextLines.description: Lines of context to show before and after each match (0-5, default: 0)

maxMatches.description: Cap on number of matching lines returned (default: 100, max: 500)

path.description: Optional file path for display only; does not affect the lookup
